title: Joeys Foodies!
description: This mod adds FOODS LIKE DONUTS AND COOKIES!
body:
**About this mod:**

This mod adds Foods to eat, make a restaraunt with, and more! This mod is good for adventures because you can make the food in survival! Donuts, cookie, and oatmeal. All can be made in survival! Its very fun to find new recipes to make new foods that make more foods! This mod is always getting worked on!

Features:

-Salt ore

-Oat plant

-Custom food!

-AND BUTTER!

**Some screenies!:**

**Want to report a bug? Go to:**

[Google form](https://forms.gle/QWtRTmJiMicGbG9y9)

Fill out the text and submit, its pretty simple.



And with that i hope you had a foodtastic day!
